entities.name: Query CoaBC protein
observations: 403 aa protein; predicted molecular weight 43.6 kDa and pI 5.38.
Closest reviewed Swiss-Prot homologs are CoaBC proteins with 43.0% identity, 97.5% query coverage, and E-value 9.65e-96.
Pfam matches cover two modules: Flavoprotein PF02441 positions 5-177 and DFP PF04127 positions 184-395.
Likely bifunctional CoA-biosynthesis enzyme, but exact activity remains homology-based for this query sequence.

entities.name: CoaBC
observations: Reviewed homolog annotation describes two sequential CoA-biosynthesis activities: phosphopantothenate--cysteine ligase and phosphopantothenoylcysteine decarboxylase.
Homologs bind FMN and require Mg2+; one reviewed Mycobacterium tuberculosis homolog is annotated as a homododecamer.

entities.name: Coenzyme A biosynthesis
observations: CoaBC catalyzes steps 2 and 3 in CoA biosynthesis from (R)-pantothenate: formation of 4-phosphopantothenoylcysteine followed by decarboxylation to 4'-phosphopantetheine.

entities.name: 4-phosphopantothenate cysteine ligation
observations: Reaction: (R)-4'-phosphopantothenate + L-cysteine + CTP → N-[(R)-4-phosphopantothenoyl]-L-cysteine + CMP + diphosphate + H(+). Rhea RHEA:19397; EC 6.3.2.5.

entities.name: Phosphopantothenoylcysteine decarboxylation
observations: Reaction: N-[(R)-4-phosphopantothenoyl]-L-cysteine + H(+) → (R)-4'-phosphopantetheine + CO2. Rhea RHEA:16793; EC 4.1.1.36.
